stack.title: Tech stack
stack.description: Nastolka is a Vue 3 single-page app talking to a Spring Boot API over REST, secured with JWT bearer tokens. History photos are stored separately in Netlify Blobs, served through Netlify Functions that authorize each request against the Spring Boot API.
stack.hosting: Hosting: Netlify (frontend + photo storage via Blobs) · Northflank + Neon (backend, Render fallback) · Northflank (Telegram bot)

backendRows.dataValue: PostgreSQL, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Flyway
backendRows.integrationsValue: BoardGameGeek XML API (search / import), Telegram Bot API (notifications)
backendRows.opsValue: Docker, Northflank (deploy, Render fallback), Neon (managed Postgres)

telegramRows.authValue: Shared bot token with the backend
telegramRows.deployValue: Northflank (Docker, webhook) · local long polling in dev

flowLogin.title: Login
flowLogin.step3: API verifies the password hash and issues a signed JWT
flowLogin.step4: Token + role are stored in the Pinia auth store and localStorage
flowLogin.step5: Redirect to Locations (or Admin, for admin accounts)

flowRegister.title: Register
flowRegister.step1: User submits username, email, and password
flowRegister.step3: API hashes the password and creates the account
flowRegister.step4: API returns a JWT for the new account, same as login
flowRegister.step5: Token is stored and the user lands on Locations

flowAuthRequest.title: Authenticated request
flowAuthRequest.step1: Client attaches Authorization: Bearer <JWT> to the request
flowAuthRequest.step2: JwtAuthFilter validates the token signature and expiry
flowAuthRequest.step3: SecurityContext is populated with the user and role
flowAuthRequest.step4: Controller handles the request; 401/403 on missing or invalid tokens

flowGameNight.title: Game night
flowGameNight.step1: Open a location and select 2+ contenders
flowGameNight.step2: Dice size is picked to fit the pool so every game gets a fair shot
flowGameNight.step4: The winning game routes to a new history entry
flowGameNight.step5: Session is logged to that location's history

flowTelegram.title: Telegram notification
flowTelegram.step1: A logged session finishes and its history entry is marked finished
flowTelegram.step2: TelegramNotifier calls the Telegram Bot API's sendMessage on the location's linked chat
flowTelegram.step3: The bot's /history command asks the backend for a chat's 5 most recent sessions, authorized by a shared secret header
flowTelegram.step4: Backend and bot share the location's Telegram chat ID as the link between them
